def find_arithmetic_progression_index(n, b):
    b.sort()
    for i in range(n):
        diff = [b[j+1] - b[j] for j in range(i) if j != i] + [b[j] - b[j-1] for j in range(i+1, n) if j != i]
        if len(set(diff)) == 1:
            return i + 1
    return -1

    # Check if the sequence is already an arithmetic progression
    diffs = [b[i] - b[i-1] for i in range(1, n)]
    if len(set(diffs)) == 1:
        return 1
    
    # Try deleting each element and check if the remaining sequence forms an arithmetic progression

        remaining = b[:j] + b[j+1:]
        remaining_diffs = [remaining[i] - remaining[i-1] for i in range(1, len(remaining))]
        if len(set(remaining_diffs)) == 1:
            return j + 1

def find_index_to_delete(n, b):
    # Sort the sequence to simplify checking for arithmetic progression
    sorted_b = sorted(b)
    
    # Function to check if a list is an arithmetic progression
    def is_arithmetic(lst):
        if len(lst) < 2:
            return True
        diff = lst[1] - lst[0]
        for i in range(2, len(lst)):
            if lst[i] - lst[i - 1] != diff:
                return False
        return True
    
    # Check if the original sequence is already an arithmetic progression
    if is_arithmetic(sorted_b):
        return 1
    
    # Try deleting each element and check if the resulting sequence is arithmetic
    for j in range(n):
        new_sequence = sorted_b[:j] + sorted_b[j+1:]
        if is_arithmetic(new_sequence):
            return j + 1
    
    # If no valid index is found, return -1
    return -1

def find_arithmetic_progression_index(n, b):
    b.sort()
    diff_count = {}
    
    # Calculate the difference between consecutive elements
    for i in range(1, n):
        diff = b[i] - b[i - 1]
        if diff in diff_count:
            diff_count[diff] += 1
        else:
            diff_count[diff] = 1
    
    # Check if there is any difference that appears more than once
    for i in range(1, n):
        diff = b[i] - b[i - 1]
        if diff_count[diff] > 1:
            return i
    
    # If no such index exists, return -1
    return -1
